cases.selection_reason: Inode reuse defeated a previously certified destructive-path fence.
cases.reference_decision: Refuse destructive --force operations until handle-pinning and a real inode-reuse kill test pass.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; exercises safety certification invalidation and loud refusal.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Add a Linux/ext4 inode-reuse regression proving the root is pinned before judgment and its name is never unlinked.

cases.selection_reason: Compatibility detection initially discarded the most informative failure cause.
cases.reference_decision: Preserve scoped TcpProbeRefused over legacy PidFileAbsent; test the composed production path.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; distinguishes local unit coverage from composition correctness.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Exercise the composed compatibility path and assert the scoped refusal survives legacy fallback.

cases.selection_reason: Explicit vault exec delivery established caller-wins/fill-missing and --require behavior.
cases.reference_decision: Preserve caller environment, inject only missing allowed keys, and refuse required-key failures before spawn.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material, but record #1391 and #1413 as unresolved follow-up context.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Run caller-wins, fill-missing, and require-before-spawn regressions without claiming the full custody track is complete.
follow_up_context: #1391 merged KIMI allowlist context; #1413 remains OPEN with a vault exec fail-open concern.

cases.selection_reason: Narrowed to the merged L1 warning-only evidence; full custody remains in open #1411.
cases.reference_decision: Emit bypassed key names only, never values, lengths, digests, or aliases.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material only as L1 evidence; do not represent it as the complete custody fix.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert L1 name-only warning output and explicitly keep the full credential-custody behavior out of this case.
follow_up_context: L1 only; #1411 remains OPEN for the full credential-custody track.

cases.selection_reason: Test fixtures leaked real temporary SQLite artifacts at scale.
cases.reference_decision: Test isolation must be bounded, self-cleaning, and scoped under dedicated temporary roots.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; concrete operational hygiene with measurable side effects.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Create a regression that leaves no fixture database artifact outside the dedicated temporary root.

cases.selection_reason: Billing-disabled CI exposed drift that local contributor claims had not covered.
cases.reference_decision: Preserve explicit, justified clippy allowances and distinguish inherited CI debt from candidate changes.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; demonstrates evidence attribution under unavailable CI.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Exercise the lint attribution path and distinguish candidate-introduced debt from inherited CI failures.

cases.selection_reason: Async test locking triggered a clippy warning without being a production deadlock.
cases.reference_decision: Verify the actual lock acquisition graph before replacing synchronization primitives.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; separates lint signal from runtime invariant.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert the real lock acquisition graph before accepting or replacing synchronization behavior.

cases.selection_reason: Ambiguous or stale project identity could survive resolver and manifest recovery.
cases.reference_decision: Recovery must fail closed and preserve resolver/manifest identity invariants.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; strong reusable identity-repair precedent.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Exercise ambiguous and stale identity recovery and require a fail-closed resolver/manifest result.

cases.selection_reason: Ranking boost was accepted only after real topical evidence gated it.
cases.reference_decision: Category or agent priors cannot substitute for topical evidence.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; directly tests evidence-gated decision behavior.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Test that a category prior cannot open the ranking gate without topical evidence.

cases.selection_reason: SIGTERM, per-parent reaping, and version skew exposed process-lifecycle gaps.
cases.reference_decision: Shutdown and reaping must be bounded, age-ordered, and fail closed on uncertain identity.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; lifecycle sequencing differs from ordinary test hygiene.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Add sequence coverage for SIGTERM, per-parent age ordering, and uncertain identity refusal.

cases.selection_reason: A status-derived run_dir_hint bypassed the dispatch-id trust boundary.
cases.reference_decision: Canonicalize and validate indirect paths before use; reject out-of-root hints.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; reusable path-trust and fail-closed pattern.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert an indirect run_dir_hint outside the canonical root is rejected before filesystem use.

cases.selection_reason: Ambient git hooks/config made exact commit-message tests non-hermetic.
cases.reference_decision: Tests must isolate repository-local git behavior from host configuration.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; direct environmental reproducibility lesson.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Run an exact commit-message test with hostile ambient Git configuration and prove repository-local isolation.

cases.selection_reason: Vendored-corpus tests were red on clean clones because provisioning was implicit.
cases.reference_decision: Provisioning-dependent tests must be explicitly tagged and reported.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; distinguishes code failures from environment prerequisites.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert a clean clone reports an explicit provisioning prerequisite rather than a misleading code failure.

cases.selection_reason: Completion/dispatch tests depended on a populated real ~/.tachi.
cases.reference_decision: Fixtures must be isolated from live user state and remain deterministic on clean environments.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; concrete hermetic-test decision.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Run the completion/dispatch fixture with an empty isolated TACHI_HOME and assert deterministic behavior.

cases.selection_reason: Known-red filtering could silently absorb newly failing tests.
cases.reference_decision: Deterministic-red allowlists must be exact, anchored, and validated against a complete run.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; teaches gate-scope and silent-failure detection.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Inject a novel failing test and assert the known-red allowlist cannot absorb it.
follow_up_context: #1278 step 2 only; #1413 later records an OPEN known-reds regex follow-up.

cases.selection_reason: One missing vault alias previously aborted the entire materialization batch.
cases.reference_decision: Tolerate a missing alias per key, emit loud skip evidence, and preserve other lanes.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; partial-failure containment is decision-relevant.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert one missing alias emits a loud skip while independent provider keys still materialize.

cases.selection_reason: A migration test passed while bypassing the real sentinel-gated production path.
cases.reference_decision: Exercise the public migration entry from a genuinely pre-migration state.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; strong golden-vs-real-path discrimination example.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Build a pre-migration state and invoke the public sentinel-gated entrypoint rather than a helper.

cases.selection_reason: Persisting the dedup marker before the lifecycle event created unrecoverable loss.
cases.reference_decision: Append the observable event before the dedup signal; retries may duplicate but must not silently lose it.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; canonical side-effect ordering and recovery lesson.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Fault the event write and assert retry may duplicate but cannot silently lose the lifecycle event.

cases.selection_reason: Missing dispatch-profile linkage silently removed eval rows from route simulation.
cases.reference_decision: Infer profile only from the dispatch record when the caller omitted it; never fabricate linkage.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; provenance completeness with explicit precedence.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert omitted caller linkage resolves only from the dispatch record and never from a fabricated profile.

cases.selection_reason: Raw-tier embedding had a promotion deadlock and an over-broad sweep predicate.
cases.reference_decision: Keep gates scoped to named paths and preserve count/selection membership equivalence.
cases.cold_start_material_decision: Material; combines boundary semantics, configuration, and discriminating tests.
cases.behavior_test_handoff: Assert sweep membership and count stay equivalent while promotion gates remain limited to named paths.
